question_summary: Elevation for the site retaining wall at Pour Sequence 4 conflicts between Grading Plan C-201 and Utility Plan C-301; which elevation governs?
proposed_solution: Use the elevation shown in Utility Plan C-301 for the site retaining wall at Pour Sequence 4; Grading Plan C-201 will be corrected by addendum.
deadline_text: Please respond at your earliest convenience.
routing_rationale: The discrepancy is between civil grading and utility plans for a site retaining wall elevation, which the Civil Engineer must resolve and update by addendum.
